gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-lepcha: Grandstander is bold and expressive, drawn at one thickness throughout. Noto Sans Lepcha does the quieter job: its wide-open curves and cast-iron-tall lowercase give the plain sans body a steady, approachable footing.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-limbu: Grandstander never varies its stroke weight, which gives its bold display letters a bouncy, expressive look. Noto Sans Limbu then carries a longer passage with tall-bodied small letters and gaping curves that stay easy on the eye.
